title: Memory CallOut Text 3
description:
“We are calling on and opening up to things firing in deep embodied memory. Maybe it is a neurological unconscious score. We say yes to imagining the physical manifestation. We flow and then catch a remembered action before it completes and glides into something that's interesting at that time. Memory is always a fiction, the more we do it the more we remember the remembering.”
----- Angie Hauser
